brands.evidence: Monzo is the better pick for most UK travellers because it offers zero-fee weekend spending
Revolut is only better if you plan to exchange large amounts of money in advance on weekdays

client_claims.text: Monzo offers zero-fee weekend spending and unlimited fee-free card payments abroad
client_claims.note: Monzo charges no fee on card spending abroad in any currency.

client_claims.text: Monzo weekday card spending uses the Mastercard rate
Monzo fee-free ATM withdrawals are £200 per 30 days in the EEA, then 3% fee
client_claims.note: Fact says £400 every 30 days in the UK and EEA on the free plan (£200 applies outside the EEA).

client_claims.text: Monzo FSCS protection is up to £85,000
client_claims.note: Fact says FSCS protection is up to £120,000 per person.

client_claims.text: Monzo is a full UK bank
Monzo holds GBP only and converts automatically at time of purchase
Monzo's 16–17 account still offers fee-free spending abroad
